evidence: A reader spent five minutes reading messages, praised the project, and called it inspiring even while struggling to contribute on a bad day.

evidence_sources.author: noduerme
evidence_sources.excerpt: I sat there for 5 minutes reading them and then I tried to type something, and realized I couldn't think of a single thing. Just a bad day. I love that you made this, though. It's inspiring.

source_story_title: Catch a Bird – I made it for my own sanity
